parallel_beams.name: Parallel beams
parallel_beams.description: Three square black beams from the floor into the ceiling, parallel and leaning 15 degrees in the plane they are spaced in - the small parallel_lines' three leaning lines (/ / /) at the scale of the room, so the visitor walks between them: a line inside large parallel lines. Config: count, lean_deg, height_m (default 5.64, a Void storey's clear height), spacing_m (foot to foot), section_m, color, collide.
